title: Find the display names of users who posted in 2011 and received more than 5
question: Find the display names of users who posted in 2011 and received more than 5 negative comments (score < 60) on their posts, where those users are among the oldest (age equals the maximum age in the users table).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_006"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_029") = '2011'
  AND T3."XCL_007" < 60
  AND T1."XCL_064" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_064") FROM users)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052"
HAVING COUNT(T3."XCL_005") > 5
